en.headline: 16 own commits, issue activity, and an OpenChamber bug closure
en.summary: **16 own commits** were recorded across three repositories on 2026-10-22. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 9 own commits added the `opencode-go-minimax` AI provider, adjusted Minimax reasoning behavior, ran temporary CI probes, refreshed codemap baselines, and corrected activity-card documentation. In `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, 6 own commits introduced an MV3 skeleton, narrowed translation to page content, added state reset and required-field validation, added DOM smoke tests and JSDoc checks, and documented repository constraints. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 1 own commit added knowledge documentation for `openchamber-storage`, including image storage, deletion sizing, and `VACUUM` procedures. There were also **4 automated commits** by `github-actions[bot]`, additional to the own-commit total. Issue activity totaled 1 item (opened or closed 1 issue); the recorded action by `sogeisetsu` was a comment on `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` issue #8, “[ai-failure] AI 叙述生成失败,” which had 5 comments. `btriapitsyn` closed `openchamber/openchamber` issue #5293, “[Bug] Project actions menu: Auto-discover dev server runs the first saved action instead of discovering a server.” No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded.

zh.headline: 16 次本人提交、issue 动态及 OpenChamber 缺陷关闭
zh.summary: 2026-10-22 共记录 **16 次本人提交**，涉及三个仓库。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 9 次本人提交加入 `opencode-go-minimax` AI provider，调整 Minimax reasoning 行为，运行临时 CI 探针，更新 codemap 基线，并修正活动卡片文档。`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 的 6 次本人提交引入 MV3 骨架，将翻译范围收窄到页面内容，增加状态重置与必填字段校验、DOM 冒烟测试和 JSDoc 检查，并记录仓库约束。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 1 次本人提交补充了 `openchamber-storage` 知识文档，涵盖图片存储、删除缩容及 `VACUUM` 流程。另有 **4 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 创建的自动提交**，这些提交不计入本人提交总数。Issue 动态总计 1 项（新开或关闭 1 个 issue）；记录到的操作是 `sogeisetsu` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` issue #8“[ai-failure] AI 叙述生成失败”中发表评论，该 issue 共 5 条评论。`btriapitsyn` 关闭了 `openchamber/openchamber` issue #5293“[Bug] Project actions menu: Auto-discover dev server runs the first saved action instead of discovering a server”。未记录 PR、评审或发布。
